message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a pale yellow background. At the top, red banners house white and black text: "Adopsi Massal Anak Indonesia oleh Orang Belanda H.26" and "Pasal Selundupan Undang-Undang P2SK H.50". Below, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered, with a smaller "5" to its right and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath.

The main headline reads "SALING KUNCI MENYIDIK KORUPSI" in bold black letters. A column of smaller black text on the left begins "Polisi menggeledah...". In the center, a large, rectangular, grey metal safe sits slightly angled. It has a round combination dial on its door.

Two men in grey uniforms and black boots are shown in a dynamic, circular pursuit around the safe. The man in the lower left foreground is running toward the right, away from the viewer; he holds a thin black object. The man on the right side of the safe is crouched, looking back toward the left, holding a magnifying glass in his right hand. Dust clouds and dark footprints trace their path on the ground. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner near text indicating "13-19 JULI 2026" and "RP 60.000".
